description: This file defines API handlers for managing 'cards' within a board in the focalboard project, including creating, retrieving, and updating cards via HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler struct for focalboard server API endpoints related to cards.

methods.name: registerCardsRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP routes for card operations.

methods.name: handleCreateCard
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to create a new card.

methods.name: handleGetCards
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve cards for a board.

methods.name: handlePatchCard
methods.description: Handles HTTP PATCH request to update a specific card.

methods.name: handleGetCard
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve a specific card.
